subject: ONE female spotted hyena, grey work shirt-apron, weary toothy grin; she/her
second_characters: ONE rat in a blue apron, envelope in paw
props: ONE thick tow rope; THREE zinc buckets; ONE plain envelope; ONE coin; TWO blue aprons
environment: deep workshop yard: benches, far fence with sparrows, a washing line of overalls near the lens, cobbles
motion_rule: the hyena moves her WHOLE body every beat, face or flank to the lens. She fills half the frame height (two thirds at 1.9-3.1), except the three close-up beats where her face, a bucket or the envelope fills the whole frame. Cuts only at 1.9, 3.6, 6.6; between them the camera arcs round her, changing angle and shot size; at 9.3 it hurls in.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.1; no words 1.45-1.9, 3.1-3.6, 5.0-5.4; last word by 6.6; after 6.6 only twang, clatter and clinks
audio.lip_sync: the hyena speaks, jaw working on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: tya-NU za tra-IKH. PLA-tyat za ad-NU. dva-IKH sa-kra-TI-li. CHIS-lyat-sya na MNE

timeline.a: mid-stride, rope taut in her paws, mouth opening on the first word
timeline.c: low three-quarter front, muzzle in view

timeline.a: first syllable at 0.1, hunched, she hauls the rope sideways left to right in one move, jaw working on every syllable, three buckets scraping behind; overalls flap in the foreground
close-up: the rope jerks her sideways; the last bucket bounces off a cobble into the lens, filling the frame

medium close from the chest; all beat she bounds left to right across the frame, snatches the rat's envelope in one jerk without slowing, rushing on, jaw working; the rat at the lower foreground edge tumbles over the lens
timeline.c: muzzle level, arcing ahead of her

timeline.a: close-up, no cut: still bounding, she thrusts the empty envelope into the lens, paper filling the frame; a coin drops out of it into the dust
head low, she hauls the rope right to left along the far fence, muzzle and flank to the lens; two blue aprons fly off the rope onto her back; an overall whips across the foreground
timeline.c: arc ahead, face and flank in view

timeline.a: the rat yanks the apron ties tight behind her; she lurches sideways, eyes bulging
in three aprons she drags the rope sideways, buckets grinding; the rat, flung off the ties, scrabbles for the coin in the foreground
the rope snaps, twang; she dives sideways, whole body, and mid-flight bites a rolling bucket's handle, clank; two buckets fly through the foreground
she scuttles sideways, the bucket in her jaws banging her chest, glancing back; in the foreground the rat bites the coin
walking sideways she kicks a bucket over the cobbles, crash; sparrows burst off the fence
the rat flicks the coin into the bucket in her jaws, clink; her knees buckle at once, she staggers forward two steps
timeline.c: low side, coin and knees in frame

timeline.a: close-up: she belly-flops onto the cobbles, sliding on her chest, bulging eyes and gaping jaws filling the lens, handle in her teeth
